about: Documented recording places of the MOT17 sequences, for qualitative geolocation checks. A sequence is 'known' only when a source states where it was filmed (URL + quote); otherwise it is 'unknown' with null coordinates. Nothing here is guessed.
checked: 2026-11-10: MOT16 paper (arXiv 1603.00831, read in full), MOTChallenge MOT17 page and Ess et al. CVPR 2008 (search snippets only; the pages could not be loaded from the build environment). Re-check those pages before treating any sequence as known.
